svg.title: cat story.txt — FROM THE GARAGE
svg.desc: My working day starts in an automotive workshop. I'm a mechanic and an entrepreneur; building software is something I do alongside that work. Discovering AI opened a new door. I began turning ideas into applications, learning as I went and using Claude and Codex to help me build, test and improve them. Mindforge is where that side of my work lives. The workshop is still part of the story. PitStop Garage MK comes directly from it. The other projects let me explore how software can help beyond the garage, too. I bring the problems and the product direction. AI helps me explore and build. The decisions and responsibility stay with me.

FROM THE GARAGE
My working day starts in an automotive
workshop. I'm a mechanic and an
entrepreneur; building software is
something I do alongside that work.
Discovering AI opened a new door. I began
turning ideas into applications, learning
as I went and using Claude and Codex to
help me build, test and improve them.
Mindforge is where that side of my work
lives.
The workshop is still part of the story.
PitStop Garage MK comes directly from it.
The other projects let me explore how
software can help beyond the garage, too.
I bring the problems and the product
direction. AI helps me explore and build.
The decisions and responsibility stay with
me.
